bundle_requirement: normal checksummed and HMAC-authenticated sealed v2 bundle

gates.name: Production reachability
gates.blocker: The isolated sealed v2 bundle proves content and evaluator reachability, not completion through the published visible UI.

gates.name: Input parity
gates.blocker: All semantic commands normalize identically, but every action has not been traversed through visible touch, mouse, keyboard, and terminal controls.

gates.name: Standalone value
gates.blocker: Direct human glance, tend, and dwell observation is mandatory.

gates.name: Atlas portability
gates.blocker: The supported browser and terminal screenshot matrix for tofu, overlap, and frame jitter is absent.

gates.name: Animal behavior
gates.blocker: Four species, deterministic choice, hysteresis, preferences, tiers, and absence are exercised, but distinct four-tier repertoires and memory-driven choice are incomplete.

gates.name: Author control
gates.blocker: The sealed beat-card arc and exact evaluator trace work, but the full named arc has not been completed end-to-end through the interactive no-JSON author UI and both materializers.

gates.name: Parallax and performance
gates.blocker: Deterministic fixed-point motion and replay are covered; browser p95 budgets, ten-minute rendered pan inspection, and terminal partial-diff acceptance are not.

gates.name: Sky accuracy and privacy
gates.blocker: Coarse local-only storage and denial fallback pass, but only two trusted Alt/Az fixtures exist instead of twelve and browser activation/network behavior lacks an acceptance run.

gates.name: Accessibility
gates.blocker: Static semantics, target sizes, and motion controls exist; VoiceOver/NVDA, no-color, 200% zoom, and narrow mobile completion require observation.

gates.name: Human acceptance
gates.blocker: Direct human sign-off cannot be replaced by code or fixture evidence.
